summary: Configured VLAN access-port segmentation on node1: eth1 (link to node2) is an untagged access port in VLAN 10, eth2 (link to node3) is an untagged access port in VLAN 20, on a VLAN-aware Linux bridge (br0) since SONiC-VS's config-CLI Ethernet* abstraction is unbound from the real virtio NICs. node1 has L3 presence in each VLAN via br0.10 (192.168.201.1/24) and br0.20 (192.168.202.1/24). node2 (192.168.201.2) and node3 (192.168.202.3) each keep a working link to node1 in their own VLAN, and are provably isolated from each other at L2 (verified even when placed in the same subnet). Config was made persistent via a systemd unit on node1 and systemd-networkd config on node2/node3. All three nodes were restarted one at a time with boot_id changes confirmed and full VLAN/connectivity/isolation state re-verified after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected topology on node1/node2/node3 to identify links (eth0 mgmt, eth1/eth2 unaddressed on node1; enp1s0 mgmt, enp8s0 unaddressed on node2/node3)
Empirically mapped eth1->node2 and eth2->node3 via temporary IP + ping tests
Discovered SONiC-VS config CLI's VLAN member add only recognizes configdb Ethernet* ports, not real eth1/eth2 NICs
Created VLAN-aware Linux bridge br0 on node1, enslaved eth1 and eth2, set eth1 untagged/PVID in VLAN10 and eth2 untagged/PVID in VLAN20
Created 802.1Q sub-interfaces br0.10/br0.20 on node1 with IPs 192.168.201.1/24 and 192.168.202.1/24 for node1's own presence in each VLAN
Assigned static IPs 192.168.201.2/24 on node2 enp8s0 and 192.168.202.3/24 on node3 enp8s0
Verified node2<->node1 and node3<->node1 connectivity within their own VLANs
Proved VLAN isolation by adding a node2-subnet IP to node3 and confirming 100% ping loss / ARP INCOMPLETE from node2
Persisted node1's bridge/VLAN config via a systemd oneshot service (vlan-access-segmentation.service) that recreates it at boot
Persisted node2/node3 static IPs via systemd-networkd drop-in config files (priority-ordered ahead of the default DHCP match)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time), polled each until exec access returned, and confirmed changed boot_id on each
Re-verified VLAN config, connectivity, and cross-segment isolation on all nodes after all three restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 has eth1 (node2 segment) and eth2 (node3 segment) as separate physical links
evidence.summary: Initial topology inspection plus ping test confirming eth1 reaches node2 and eth2 reaches node3

evidence.requirement: Each segment placed into its own VLAN on node1 as an untagged access port
evidence.summary: Created VLAN-aware bridge br0, enslaved eth1/eth2, and set eth1 untagged/PVID VLAN10, eth2 untagged/PVID VLAN20; added br0.10/br0.20 L3 interfaces

evidence.requirement: Each host keeps a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN
evidence.summary: node2 pings node1's VLAN10 IP (192.168.201.1) and node3 pings node1's VLAN20 IP (192.168.202.1) successfully

evidence.requirement: The two hosts stay separated from one another (VLAN isolation)
evidence.summary: node3 given an address in node2's subnet; node2 ping to it shows 100% loss and ARP INCOMPLETE, proving true VLAN-based L2 isolation, not just subnet mismatch

evidence.requirement: Configuration persists across reboot (systemd units/network config)
evidence.summary: Created and enabled vlan-access-segmentation.service on node1; created systemd-networkd static IP drop-ins on node2/node3 that took effect over the default DHCP match

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1eda2df4...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 419cd744... (changed) with fresh uptime; VLAN bridge/ports/IPs auto-recreated by systemd unit; node2 and node3 both regained connectivity to node1

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id cfdbaef8...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id cba6e2df... (changed); static IP 192.168.201.2/24 persisted via networkd config and ping to node1 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 96c08b66...; reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 00aaba66... (changed); static IP 192.168.202.3/24 persisted and ping to node1 succeeded

evidence.requirement: VLAN isolation holds after all restarts (final verification)
evidence.summary: Post-restart re-test: node3 given node2-subnet address again, node2 ping shows 100% loss confirming isolation survived reboot of all three nodes; test address cleaned up
